issue: विघ्नहरन हे रवि सुव्रन: सुव्रन is not a word; the sense wants सुवन ('son': O son of the Sun). The book and Drik Panchang both print सुव्रन; no other witness was found.
our reading: विघ्नहरन हे रवि सुव्रन (as printed): O son of the Sun, remover of obstacles.

issue: इकहोइ धारण करत शनि नित । वंदत सोई शनि को दमनचित: the subject is not named.
our reading: The three gods, being one form (chaupāī 26), ever hold Śani in mind and bow to him with minds subdued.
alternatives: Any devotee: 'whoever single-mindedly holds Śani in mind daily bows to him with mind subdued'.

issue: शनि सम ध्यान: सम as 'even, steady' or 'like'.
our reading: Who daily meditates on Śani with an even mind.

issue: कीन्हौं विमल तैयार: the book prints विमल in quotation marks, as the preparer's name.
alternatives: विमल 'pure': 'this reading has been made ready, pure'.

issue: ललिता लिखें सुधार: ललिता as the poet's name (the glossary's reading).
our reading: Lalitā has refined and written it in sweet, fine language.
